Home CTA description: Put Vector Epoch Relay between your applications and model providers—stable, observable, and always under control.
Home FAQ answer 1: Vector Epoch Relay is an enterprise multi-model API gateway for unified provider access, request routing, access control, usage analysis, and operational visibility.
Home FAQ answer 2: When an application binds directly to multiple providers, routing, retries, keys, and billing become scattered across services. A gateway gives the application one stable entry point.
Home FAQ answer 3: The platform supports common OpenAI, Responses, Claude, and Gemini API routes, while upstream channels and model mappings can be configured in the console.
Home FAQ answer 4: It is for engineering and platform teams that need multiple model providers with clear reliability, permission boundaries, traffic ownership, and cost visibility.
